import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Generate Class A: 5000 points from normal distribution with mean (0,0) and std 1
class_a = np.random.normal(loc=[0, 0], scale=1, size=(5000, 2))

# Generate Class B: 5000 points from normal distribution with mean (0.5, 0.5) and std 1
class_b = np.random.normal(loc=[0.5, 0.5], scale=1, size=(5000, 2))

# Create the scatter plot

plt.scatter(class_a[:, 0], class_a[:, 1], c='blue', alpha=0.1, label='Class A')

# Add legend
plt.legend()

# Add title
plt.title('Dense Scatter')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')

print("Scatter plot saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}
